scenarios.name: Pantry capacity shortage
scenarios.description: Pantries cannot hold the entire donation.

scenarios.name: Exact driver capacity
scenarios.description: Driver capacity exactly matches assigned food.

scenarios.name: Pickup deadline boundary
scenarios.description: Pickup completes exactly at the allowed deadline.

scenarios.name: Multi-stop driver route
scenarios.description: One driver serves multiple compatible pantries.

scenarios.name: Driver shift violation
scenarios.description: Proposed route ends after the driver's shift.

scenarios.name: Overlapping driver assignment
scenarios.description: Driver already has a RescueMesh route during the proposed pickup window.

scenarios.name: Pantry capacity disruption
scenarios.description: A pantry loses capacity after a rescue has already been planned.

scenarios.name: Safe in-transit recovery
scenarios.description: A disruption occurs while food is in transit and a fully safe alternative plan exists.

scenarios.name: Partial in-transit recovery
scenarios.description: A disruption leaves only a partial rescue possible, creating a genuine tradeoff.
